items.title: Building an infinite compatible sequence of thickenings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For pairwise non-specializing non-versal finite type points u_n: choose open neighborhoods U' separating u_n from earlier points; apply lemma-single-point to get x -> y_n over U -> T_n with the three conditions; define U_1 = T_1 and U_{n+1} = U_n ⊔_U T_{n+1} inductively, obtain x_{n+1} over U_{n+1} from (RS*) restricting to x_n and y_{n+1}; properties (1) and (2) follow from the pushout construction and property (3) transfers after shrinking because the open subschemes of T_n and U_n are isomorphic.
